title: build-realapp-011
universal_lens: A pricing cadence discrepancy induces a temporal aliasing operator between weekly Stripe price lattices and monthly UI renderings. The checkout readiness guard forms a predicate lattice over deployment artifacts, where duplicate gate equivalence classes partition command-space into extension vs. novel trajectories. Compliance boundaries define a constraint manifold excluding founder-methodology leakage.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian evidence accumulation over route screenshots (likelihood) updates posterior over cadence authority. Conformal prediction sets on checkout verification status yield coverage guarantees for launch classification P0. The duplicate gate acts as a sufficiency statistic collapsing BUILD-CMD-036 extension evidence into a single latent cadence parameter.
gse_mapping: State-transition system: (Current: monthly UI, weekly Stripe) → (Desired: unified cadence + guard). Affected files define the transition kernel. Legal boundary is an absorbing constraint state. Deployment readiness probe is a stopping time with typecheck/lint/build as filtration. Owner approval gates the transition to live Stripe verification.

The core mathematical tension is a temporal aliasing between two price lattices: Stripe's weekly discrete-time price process {p_w[t]} and the UI's monthly rendering {p_m[t]}. The aliasing operator \mathcal{A} maps weekly→monthly via aggregation kernel k (weeks-per-month). This is a decimation filter on the price lattice. The checkout guard \Gamma is a predicate over the deployment filtration {\mathcal{F}_t} where \tau_i are measurable stopping conditions. The duplicate gate \sim_{DG} partitions command-space into equivalence classes where BUILD-REALAPP-011 is an extension of BUILD-CMD-036 — this is a quotient space construction. The compliance manifold \mathcal{M}_{\text{comp}} is a constraint submanifold defined by forbidden feature detectors. Failure modes: (1) k\notin\mathbb{N} breaks \mathcal{A} isomorphism; (2) \tau_i undecidability makes \Gamma non-computable; (3) ID collision collapses \sim_{DG}; (4) dynamic feature injection escapes \mathcal{M}_{\text{comp}}. The launch classification P0; difficulty M implies the transition kernel must satisfy \mathbb{P}(\Gamma=1 \land f\in\mathcal{M}_{\text{comp}}) > 1-\alpha for \alpha\approx0.01.
